archetypes.name: robustness
archetypes.rationale: The suffix-stripping loop in _normalize_reviewer_output_basename and the three-tier status lookup in write_reviewer_status_tsv have multi-suffix and basename-collision edge cases that fall outside the static correctness/edge-cases pass.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit the new write_reviewer_status_tsv function and its helpers in python/plan_review_round.py. Focus on: (1) whether _normalize_reviewer_output_basename correctly handles compound suffixes like -phase2-retry (the while+for+else loop strips one suffix per iteration — verify it converges and produces the right stem); (2) whether the three-tier status lookup (exact output path → normalized basename → realpath) can assign a wrong status when two launched slots produce files with the same basename in different directories (status_by_norm_basename retains the last writer); (3) whether contextlib.suppress(OSError) at the call sites in execute_round and _run_round_body may silently discard meaningful failures the operator should see; (4) whether the duplicate fallback block that writes a header-only TSV when write_reviewer_status_tsv returns None appears identically in both the panel-dispatch-failure and PANEL_PRUNED_EMPTY terminals and could diverge under maintenance. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: integration-paths
archetypes.rationale: The _run_round_body subprocess branch dropped the is_symlink check from its outer condition and the new empty-paths else branch rewrites collector-results.env to empty; these cross-path state mutations need symmetry verification.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the integration between the two round execution paths (subprocess via RUN_STEP3_PLAN_REVIEW_LOOP_SH in python/plan_review.py _run_round_body, and in-process via execute_round in python/plan_review_round.py) for the new reviewer-status.tsv producer. Focus on: (1) the _run_round_body condition changed from 'if round_status.is_file() and not round_status.is_symlink()' to 'if not round_status.is_file()' — confirm that calling write_reviewer_status_tsv when round_status is a dangling symlink is fully safe given the out.is_symlink() guard inside the function; (2) the new else branch in execute_round writes an empty collector-results.env when paths_path is missing or empty — verify this correctly prevents write_reviewer_status_tsv from reading a stale prior-round collector-results.env in subsequent calls; (3) whether the panel-dispatch-failure terminal passes collect_text='' rather than reading the (possibly stale) on-disk collector-results.env, and whether that is the right choice for a run that never reached collection. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
